title: Repoint AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN for production and verify the deploy-role workflows
description:
Repoint the AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN secrets and variables for production to the production account role. verify-account-deploy-role exists only on main now: check it can be dispatched and that the staging environment accepts main.

Feature: Deploy role verification
  Scenario: Dispatch
    Given the variables are repointed
    When verify-account-deploy-role is dispatched on main for staging and production
    Then both environments assume their roles

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done 2026-10-15. Staging environment secret was repointed earlier; the production environment secret AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN is now repointed to the production-account role. verify-account-deploy-role passed for staging and production. deploy-auth-production, deploy-thinturn-production and deploy-controlplane-production ran green from GitHub Actions, and staging thinturn and controlplane CI deploys are green.

right_now_summary: Production now uses its account role, and staging and production role checks and deploys pass.
